   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  SEPTEMBER 8, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:03 p.m. Responding to roll call were Chair Leon, Vice Chair
Ang, Commissioner Sanchez, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Lopez. Also present was Levy
Sun, Director of Communications, Wendy Sahagun-Guzman, Community Information Assistant and
Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior Management Analyst.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes for August
11, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responders Luncheon

Mr. Sun provided Commissioners with a printed copy of the letter created by Chair Leon that is to
accompany the placemats that will be delivered by Commissioners to local elementary schools
requesting their participation in the artwork created for the event.

Business Spotlight

Mr. Sun showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the August Pet Groomer Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Commissioners acknowledged the different style of videos that is leaning more on the
humorous side.  Mr. Sun explained the humor and fast pacing of the videos increases
completion/retention according to analytics. Next month’s theme is bakeries.

Merchandise Surveys

Mr. Sun stated that the Commission was able to obtain 620 merchandise surveys through their efforts
at various city events. Mr. Sun provided Commissioners with the results of the design votes.
Commission discussed various points regarding merchandise material, design, and proceeds;
discussion regarding pricing and local print shops or businesses based on Commissioners’ research
will continue at the next meeting.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mr. Sun provided Historical Heritage Commission meeting dates and asked which they preferred to
attend to make their presentation on a possible collaboration. Commissioners agreed on October 27,
2025, at 4:30 pm. Commissioner Sanchez will be unable to attend. Mr. Sun informed the Commission
that at their next meeting they will have guests from Cerritos College Native Plant Sanctuary and the
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting

September 8, 2025

Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control to discuss a possible Native Plant Landscaping Contest
collaboration.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez informed everyone that the Mary Paxon Art Gallery is hosting an exhibit on the
Arturo Sanchez Sr. Halloween Parade’s 40 years. Commissioner Sanchez confirmed six (6) bands and
is expecting 95 to 105 entries. Vice Chair Ang discussed he attended a presentation by the Water
Reclamation District and can see them as potential partner/collaborator for the Commission.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

Norwalk Resident, Jack Cornejo, stated he enjoyed the humorous approach the Business Spotlight
videos are taking and noted the great editing work being done on them. Mr. Cornejo is also excited
that city merchandise will be coming soon and advised that he would appreciate it if the Commission
looked into obtaining heavy duty cotton for the T-shirts. Mr. Cornejo also liked the possible
collaborations the Commission is doing regarding Native Landscaping and suggested considering a
collaboration with the Art in Public Places Commission to create landscape as a public art concept.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:13 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
